proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#9
proposed.text: Trapped in a time loop, Enoch gives up the part that keeps him running so the team can fix the time drive, and Deke thanks him before he dies.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The Chronicom who gives his life again, this time to fix the time drive.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A friend who thanks Enoch as he gives his life to fix the time drive.

changes.evidence: In 'As I Have Always Been' (S7#9) Enoch willingly removes his displacement mechanism to repair the Zephyr's time drive and dies; Deke pats him on the back in gratitude and promises Simmons the sacrifice will not be in vain. Earlier in S7#6 Deke shocks Enoch, thinking him a traitor, then apologizes and calls him family.

proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6#9
proposed.text: After learning that his grandfather died, Deke is reunited with the Fitz who survived in space, and the two start to bond as grandfather and grandson.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Deke's grandfather. Deke bonds with the Fitz who survives.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Fitz's grandson, who bonds with him after his other self dies.

changes.evidence: In S6#7 Deke learns his grandfather (the Fitz of S5) died; in S6#9 ('Collision Course Part II') he is overjoyed to meet the surviving Fitz ('Bobo') after the Shrike tower falls, and in S6#10-12 they work together, clash over Deke's stolen tech and Deke admits feeling unwanted by his family.

now.title: Luke Cage S1#9
now.text: Diamondback supplies the Hammer weapons that Cottonmouth sells to Domingo Colon. When the business sours, Diamondback tells Colon he can buy or die.
now.on_a_card_about_b: A buyer of Diamondback's Hammer guns, told to buy or die.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The gun supplier who tells Colon to buy or die.

proposed.text: Furious that Harlem's bosses no longer buy his Hammer guns, Diamondback kills them all at Colon's gym but spares Colon, telling him to warn the others never to cross him.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A gang boss Diamondback spares when he kills the others at his gym.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The gun supplier who kills the other bosses in Colon's gym but spares him.

changes.evidence: In S1#9 ('DWYCK') Diamondback interrupts Mariah's meeting at Colon's gym, kills Hong, Alef, Barnwell and Castro, spares Colon because he has no beef with his cousins, and tells him to warn other bosses. There is no 'buy or die' exchange.

proposed.title: Luke Cage S1#7
proposed.text: Diamondback, who knows Luke as Carl, shoots him with a Judas bullet, the first bullet that can pierce his skin.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The bulletproof man Diamondback shoots with a Judas bullet.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The man who shoots Luke with a Judas bullet.

changes.evidence: At the end of S1#7 ('Manifest') Diamondback fires a Judas bullet into Luke's stomach while he walks with Claire; the half-brother reveal follows in S1#8, so the connection starts one title earlier.

proposed.title: The Punisher S2#11
proposed.text: Karen and Madani examine the bodies of the three women Frank is blamed for and learn Russo killed them, then help Frank slip out of the hospital.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A reporter who works with Madani to clear Frank of the women's murders.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A Homeland agent who works with Karen to clear Frank of the women's murders.

changes.evidence: In S2#11 Madani joins Karen in wanting to help Frank; together they examine the corpses in the morgue and learn the women were executed by Russo, and Karen sets off the fire alarm while Madani sneaks Frank out.

proposed.title: The Punisher S2#2
proposed.text: Krista Dumont, Russo's therapist, sends Madani out of his hospital room and insists he cannot be faking his memory loss.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Russo's therapist, who defends him and sends Madani away.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: An agent who keeps visiting Russo, whom Krista sends away.

changes.evidence: In S2#2 ('Fight or Flight') Dumont finds Madani tormenting Russo, says he is incapable of faking, and asks her to leave; in S2#3 they argue again after his escape. They meet well before the S2#12 fight.

now.title: The Punisher S2#12
now.text: Krista Dumont first helps Dinah Madani, then turns on her to protect Billy Russo. They try to kill each other.
now.on_a_card_about_b: A therapist who helps Madani, then turns on her to protect Russo.
now.on_b_card_about_a: An agent Krista helps, then turns on to protect Russo.

proposed.text: Madani grows suspicious of Krista, who has been pumping her for information about Frank for Russo, and when Madani finds proof Russo has been staying with her, they fight and Madani pushes Krista out a window.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Russo's therapist, who pumps Madani for information and whom Madani pushes out a window.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: An agent Krista pumps for information for Russo, who pushes her out a window.

changes.evidence: Krista never helps Madani: in S2#10 she shares wine with her while Russo listens, then uses what Madani says to plan the trap for Frank. In S2#12 Madani grows suspicious, finds proof Russo was there, they fight and Madani pushes Dumont out the window.

proposed.title: The Punisher S2#7
proposed.text: James coaches Madani through a cover story that keeps her job and Frank's freedom, and when Madani later asks her advice about Frank and Russo, James tells her to let them kill each other.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A CIA official who coaches Madani through a cover story and advises her to stay out of Frank's war.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: An agent James coaches through a cover story and advises on Frank and Russo.

changes.evidence: S2#7 ('One Bad Day'): in a flashback James stops Madani's taped interview to talk her into the 'least worst' lie, and in the present Madani meets James in New York for advice; James tells her to stay out of it and let Castle and Russo kill each other.

proposed.title: Luke Cage S1#1
proposed.text: Domingo Colon meets Mariah and Cottonmouth at Harlem's Paradise about their new partnership, and Mariah rebuffs his idea that his money buys him political protection.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A gang boss Mariah rebuffs when he wants political protection.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A councilwoman who rebuffs Colon's idea of buying her protection.

changes.evidence: In S1#1 Colon joins Stokes and Dillard at Harlem's Paradise to talk about their partnership; he calls her help a get-out-of-jail-free card and she corrects him that she does not make that kind of deal. This is before the S1#9 deal.

proposed.title: Jessica Jones S3#8
proposed.text: Dorothy sets up Jessica's interview warning Gregory Sallinger's next victim and tells her she is proud of both her daughters, shortly before Sallinger kills her.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Dorothy's adoptive daughter, whom she finally says she is proud of before her death.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Jessica's adoptive mother, who says she is proud of her shortly before Sallinger kills her.

changes.evidence: In S3#8 ('AKA Camera Friendly') Dorothy begs Thembi Wallace to interview Jessica about Sallinger, applauds her and says how proud she is of her two daughters; that night Sallinger tortures and kills her. In S3#1 she also asks Jessica to find Trish.

proposed.title: Luke Cage S2#13
proposed.text: Disappointed when Luke takes over Harlem's Paradise, D.W. tells him Pop's is neutral ground where he can get a haircut but not talk business.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: D.W.'s hero, whom he scolds for taking over Harlem's Paradise.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A young fan who scolds Luke for taking over Harlem's Paradise.

changes.evidence: In S2#13 Cage accepts Dillard's club; D.W., disappointed and angry, tells him Pop's is Switzerland and he can come for a haircut but cannot talk shop there, and Cage complies.

proposed.title: Agent Carter S2#9
proposed.text: Stranded in the desert after Whitney Frost shoots Ana, Jarvis blames Peggy and they trade bitter words, until he admits Ana can no longer have children and they make up.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Close friend Jarvis blames after Ana is shot, before they make up.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Close friend who blames Peggy after Ana is shot, before they make up.

changes.evidence: In S2#9 ('A Little Song and Dance') Jarvis blames Carter for letting Dottie loose, says everyone around her dies, she accuses him of treating missions as adventures; he then reveals Ana cannot have children, she apologizes, and they escape together.

proposed.title: The Defenders#6
proposed.text: Elektra kills Alexandra in front of Gao and the other Hand leaders and declares herself the new leader of the Hand.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A Hand founder who watches Elektra kill Alexandra and take over.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The Black Sky, who kills Alexandra and takes over the Hand.

changes.evidence: End of Defenders #6 Elektra murders Alexandra before the remaining fingers and claims leadership; in #7 Gao, seeking peace, explains the Hand's ties to her and they follow her, and in #8 Gao works beside her in the cavern. Same turn already recorded for Murakami.

proposed.title: The Defenders#8
proposed.text: Beneath Midland Circle, Elektra remembers who she was and stays with Matt as the building collapses, and they kiss.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Elektra's first love, whom she remembers and kisses as the building falls.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Matt's first love, who remembers him and stays with him as the building falls.

changes.evidence: In Defenders #8 Murdock stays behind to plead with Natchios; she apologizes for the pain she caused him, says they are together, and they kiss as Midland Circle implodes on them. The relationship turns back from enemy.

proposed.title: The Defenders#5
proposed.text: At the Royal Dragon, Elektra knocks Murakami away to stop him killing Matt, and Murakami starts urging the other Hand leaders to stop relying on her.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A Hand founder Elektra knocks down to save Matt.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The Black Sky, who attacks Murakami to save Matt.

changes.evidence: Defenders #5 ('Take Shelter'): when Murdock calls her Elektra she flees, but not before preventing Murakami from killing him; Murakami then questions Alexandra's reliance on the Black Sky. This happens before the #6 takeover.

proposed.title: Daredevil S2#10
proposed.text: Stick sends an assassin to kill Elektra. She kills the man and learns her old mentor sent him.

proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Stick's old pupil, whom he sends an assassin to kill.

now.title: Daredevil S2#12
now.text: Flashbacks show Stick training Elektra as a child to fight the Hand, raising her as his weapon.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Elektra's mentor. Trains her as a child to fight the Hand.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Stick's pupil, raised from childhood as his weapon against the Hand.

proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Stick's pupil, raised as his weapon, who saves him from the Hand.

proposed.text: Fisk has Elena killed when she will not leave her building, and Karen is called in to identify her body.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Friend at Nelson and Murdock, who identifies Elena's body.

owner_calls.question: Keep this connection? Kilgrave mind-controlled the whole 15th Precinct, Costa among them, and never knew him by name; Costa only tells Jessica about it later, saying the nightmares stopped when she killed Kilgrave and that this is why he trusts her.
options: Keep: being forced to hold a gun to his head is a direct, lasting effect on Costa
Drop: Kilgrave never knew Costa; he was one cop in a crowd
owner_calls.evidence: Costa recounts in JJ S2#5 that during Kilgrave's takeover of the precinct (JJ S1) he was made to hold his gun to his head; Costa is not on screen in S1 and the two share no title.

owner_calls.question: Enoch's men freeze and take the team, Yo-Yo included, at the diner at the end of AoS S4#22, but he is only a silhouette there and is not named until S5. Move the first stage to S4#22, or keep S5#1 where he is seen and sends them to the future?
options: Move stage 0 to Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#22 and keep the text to the diner abduction
owner_calls.evidence: World's End (S4#22): a group led by a silhouetted man (credited 'Silhouetted Man', later Enoch) freezes Coulson's team at Rae's Restaurant and takes them; S5#1 shows the Lighthouse and the Monolith.
